title: Assessment of Neurocognitive Symptom Trajectories in Daily Life after a COVID-19 Infection (COVISION)
summary: In the current study, our aim is to investigate how various symptoms change over the course of the day and week in individuals with post-COVID syndrome. We are particularly interested in cognitive symptoms (e.g. decline in memory or attention) and fatigue. We want to determine the impact of daily activities and socio-economic factors on the progression of these symptoms.
conditions: post-covid-19; specifically fatigue and cognitive functioning

interventions.name:
N = 50 participants above the age of 18 and of all genders that suffer from any post-covid-19 syndrom.

The patients will be invited to participate in a short survey and cognitive testing via text message twice a day for 2 weeks. The survey will inquire about the current intensity of their symptom

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
We are recruiting participants that suffer from post-covid-19 symptoms and that are able to operate a web-based application in german
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria are pre-existing neurological conditions (that are independent of the post-covid-19 condition), current or prior psychotic illness or substance-dependence; other intellectual or mental disorders that are characterized by cognitive impairments; current treatment for cognitive impairments (with the exception being self-treatment, e.g. by using cognitive training applications); pre-existing conditions with fatigue as the main symptom; and pregnant women.
